To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we systematically analyzed 150 anticancers and identified 133 novel anticancer drug-cancer associations.
we collected a comprehensive data source of anticancer drugs and performed a detailed data analysis and application in term of historical trend and networks.

1) the proportion of targeted drugs is increasing in recent years; 2) the targeted drugs tend to be delivered as the signal drug; 3) most of the targets are located on the plasma membranes and belong to enzymes, especially tyrosines kinases; 4) most of the targeted drugs tend only to treat a few cancer types; 5) we discovered 133 drug-cancer associations by using the common target-based strategy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the systematic analysis of FDA approved anticancer drugs and the potential application in drug repurposing.
the discovery of new anticancers, and it may contribute to the development of new anticancer drug discovery.
the systematic analysis of anticancer drugs and provides a valuable data source to the scientific community.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the FDA-approved drugs have the potential to treat more cancers than we thought.
the anticancer drug repurpose is promising to be a valuable strategy for drug development.
the FDA-approved anticancer drug database is a valuable resource for the systematic investigation of anticancer drugs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the data and the analysis in this study would contribute to the systematic anticancer drug discovery.
the data and analysis provided in this study would be helpful for anticancer drug discovery.
the drug-cancer association network is a promising approach to discover novel anticancer drugs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the systematic analysis of anticancer drugs could contribute to a deeper understanding of the drug discovery process, and could help identify novel anticancer drugs and drug repurposing.
the drug-cancer network and cancer-drug-target networks are valuable resources for the anticancer drug development.
the drug-target-based approach is promising for the systematic investigation of anticancer drugs and the discovery of novel drug-cancer association.
